_comment: Koaai (bundle) — for hosts WITHOUT GHCR access. Upload koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip (from any GitHub release) via the file manager, or set BUNDLE_URL and the install script downloads it. Secrets come from variables below, never from files.
name: Koaai (Bundle)
author: kurenai@koaai.dev
description: Koaai via portable bundle: upload koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip (koaai + bin/yt-dlp + bin/node) or give a download URL. No Docker knowledge needed.
startup: if [ -d bin ]; then export PATH="$(pwd)/bin:$PATH"; fi; if [ ! -f .env ] && [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then printf 'TOKEN=%s\n' "$TOKEN" > .env; fi; exec ./koaai

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Koaai (bundle) install: needs koaai + bin/yt-dlp + bin/node in /mnt/server.
# Either upload koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip via the file manager first,
# or set BUNDLE_URL to a direct zip link (e.g. the GitHub release asset).
cd /mnt/server

if [ ! -f koaai ] || [ ! -f bin/yt-dlp ]; then
    if [ -f koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip ]; then
        echo "zip found - extracting..."
    elif [ -n "${BUNDLE_URL:-}" ]; then
        echo "downloading bundle..."
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip "$BUNDLE_URL" || { echo "download failed"; exit 1; }
    else
        echo "ERROR: upload koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip first, or set BUNDLE_URL, then Reinstall."
        exit 1
    fi
    if command -v unzip >/dev/null; then
        unzip -oq koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip
    else
        python3 -m zipfile -e koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip .
    fi
fi

chmod +x koaai bin/yt-dlp bin/node 2>/dev/null || true

echo "--- verifying ---"
./koaai --version 2>/dev/null || file koaai | head -1
./bin/yt-dlp --version || { echo "YT-DLP BROKEN"; exit 1; }
./bin/node --version  || { echo "NODE BROKEN"; exit 1; }

echo "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Bundle URL
variables.description: Direct link to koaai-bundle-linux-x64.zip (e.g. GitHub release asset). Leave empty if you upload the zip yourself.

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: Your Discord user ID - unlocks the report dashboard in DMs.

variables.name: Dev Guild ID
variables.description: Scope slash-command registration to one guild while testing. Leave empty for global registration.
